campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from NC State University Housing's official hall pages. NC State is unusually thorough: almost every residence hall publishes a room-details table with exact length x width x ceiling height plus measured desk, dresser, wardrobe, closet, bed-frame and microfridge footprints, so most rooms here are recorded at high confidence straight from those tables. Suites are modeled per bedroom so occupant counts and layouts match cleanly. Residence-hall beds are extra-long twin (36" x 80") on loftable frames; the Wolf Ridge and Wolf Village apartments use full-size beds instead, which is flagged on those rooms because Twin XL bedding will not fit them.
